subject: Request: initial credit bump + SLA waiver for pilot evaluation
messages:
From: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@tidalwave.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask — extra credits and short trial extension

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at TidalWave is excited by the latency profile and the observability surface. We have a tight internal timeline and would like to accelerate an end-to-end evaluation. Two asks from my side:

1) Can Redwood push an initial credit allocation to cover ~150k generation tokens (we expect heavy prompt iteration in week 1)?
2) Would you consider extending the standard 30-day pilot to 90 days so our platform team can validate integrations and an A/B evaluation window?

Both items are critical for us to move to a paid pilot by end of Q3. I know these are exceptions — happy to share the mutual action plan and expected ARR if helpful.

If needed, loop in whoever on your side to make this possible.

Best,
Ryan
Ryan Cole
VP Engineering, TidalWave Systems
ryan.cole@tidalwave.io
+1 (415) 555-2198
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@tidalwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — extra credits and short trial extension

Ryan — thanks for the clear ask and for walking us through the use case.

High level response: we can usually accommodate either credits OR a longer pilot, but combined asks require an exec exception. I27m looping in Marissa (manager) to request approval.

Proposed commercial starter (what I27m asking Marissa to clear):
- One-time initial credit: 150,000 generation tokens (token accounting as per our MAP)
- Pilot duration: extend to 90 days
- Pilot discount: 20% on billed overage during the first paid month (if we convert)
- One-time request: temporary SLA carveout for pilot (no standard SLA credit exposure; we27d still provide 24/7 support)

Why this is reasonable: TidalWave is a clear product-led fit (real-time inference at scale) and the internal stakeholder map shows three product teams that will run live comparisons. If we get to a paid contract, expected first-year commit is $220k ARR per the MAP (attached).

Attachments: TidalWave_MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan), pilot_contract_redline.docx

Marissa — can you review and confirm whether we can approve credits + extension + the SLA carveout? If you27d like, I can add a 2-sentence executive justification for your signature.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — extra credits and short trial extension

Nikhil — thanks for pulling this together. I have a couple of asks before we sign off:

1) Quantify adoption signals we27ll require to consider the concession successful (example: 3 feature flags enabled, 10k daily inference calls from production traffic, exec sponsor engaged).
2) Confirm whether the SLA carveout is limited strictly to credit exposure during the pilot and that we retain the right to revert to standard SLA on conversion. This needs legal sign-off.
3) Finance: we need a crisp one-paragraph ROI/ARR justification for internal approval. Include the expected 12-month ARR and conversion likelihood.

Aditya 2D fyi: can you weigh in on the SLA waiver for pilot customers? If we27re asking to remove SLA credit exposure during the evaluation, I27d like a quick thumbs up or suggested guardrails (time-limited, restricted to non-prod endpoints, etc.).

Once Nikhil returns the quant, I27ll escalate to Exec signoff.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@tidalwave.io>, TidalWave Legal <legal@tidalwave.io>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — extra credits and short trial extension

Marissa / Aditya — thank you. Per your asks, here27s the condensed executive justification and measurable adoption milestones: please use this for approval ribbon.

Executive justification (one paragraph):
TidalWave is a high-velocity prospect with immediate product use cases for low-latency inference across three product teams. Granting a one-time credit allocation and a 90-day pilot extension materially reduces evaluation friction, increasing our expected conversion probability from ~30% to ~65% within 90 days and unlocking an expected first-year committed ARR of $220K. The requested SLA carveout is narrowly scoped to pilot endpoints and will have a time-boxed effect, preserving our ability to enforce standard SLAs on conversion.

Adoption milestones (pass/fail criteria for concession):
- Integration: TidalWave must run at least one end-to-end integration with production-like traffic within 45 days.
- Signal: >= 10k daily inference calls OR 3 separate feature flags actively routing traffic to Redwood during the pilot window.
- Sponsor engagement: exec sponsor (VP Eng) must attend the fortnightly checkpoint with Redwood CS.

Final ask (what I need you to approve):
- One-time initial credit: 150,000 generation tokens (TidalWave_MAP_v1.pdf)
- Pilot length: 90 days total (start date: 2027-07-22)
- Commercial concession: 20% discount on first paid month if conversion occurs within 30 days post-pilot
- SLA carveout: waive SLA credit exposure for the pilot window for pilot endpoints only (time-boxed to the 90-day pilot).

Attachments: TidalWave_MAP_v1.pdf, pilot_contract_redline.docx, adoption_forecast.xlsx
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8754/DL-2027-0892, https://www.docusign.com/sandbox/envelope/ABC12345

If you27re good with the language I27ll drop it into the DocuSign redline and get legal to confirm the carveout wording. Ryan — once we have the signoff we27ll issue the credits and extend the pilot window.

Thanks,
Nikhil
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
